translations.web: When you have finished cleansing it, you shall offer a young bull without defect, and a ram out of the flock without defect.
translations.bsb: When you have finished the purification, you are to present a young, unblemished bull and an unblemished ram from the flock.
translations.kjv: When thou hast made an end of cleansing it, thou shalt offer a young bullock without blemish, and a ram out of the flock without blemish.
translations.asv: When thou hast made an end of cleansing it, thou shalt offer a young bullock without blemish, and a ram out of the flock without blemish.
